summary: The candidate skill 'Quantile Scale Quantiles Inspection' is a narrower, single-method subset of the existing peer skill 'Quantile Scale Inspection and Cloning'. Both target the same semantic capability (quantile threshold retrieval from d3.scaleSequentialQuantile), same asset layer (micro_skill), same task_family (scale_inspection), and same stage (scale introspection/validation). The peer skill already encompasses .quantiles() inspection plus the additional .copy() capability. Merging the candidate into the peer consolidates overlapping guidance without loss of functionality.
